text: Premier Padel was founded by Qatar Sports Investments (QSI) together with the International Padel Federation (FIP) and the Professional Padel Association, and launched in 2022; in August 2023 QSI acquired World Padel Tour to create a single global tour governed by FIP. QSI is wholly owned by the Qatar Investment Authority.
short: QSI founded and owns Premier Padel
